title: Moon 2 Mars Space Radiation Protection: "Buying Down" Risks to Crew (Simonsen, Zawaski, Weeks)
publisher: NASA HQ / NASA JSC (NTRS 20250006168, ASCEND draft)
note: Read 13 Nov 2026. ISS: 0.2 to 0.5 mSv/day (~40-90 mSv per six-month mission). Table 1 (GCR, optimized shielding): lunar surface ~0.4 (solar max) to ~0.9 (solar min), Mars surface ~0.35 to ~0.65, free space ~0.6 to ~1.3. Table 1 prints "mSv/yr"; its own comparison column ("two to three times higher than ISS", "similar to ISS") and the ISS rate in the text show per-day values are meant.
